card.title: Join Me
card.instruction: Recruit someone into a secret plan.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will you help me set up Denise's surprise leaving party at seven?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I spent the last one washing glasses.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll wash up. Could you get Denise out of the office while I decorate?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She won't leave before I finish her spreadsheet.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Send it over. I'll finish her spreadsheet; could you take her for coffee and complain about how little I do?

mechanism: A recruits a colleague to distract the departing guest while taking over burdens that previously discouraged help.
confusable: Unlike general party planning, A must negotiate B's participation in hiding the preparations.
comparison: D07-b makes the complaint about A part of the cover; D07-a uses a pastry lesson to occupy Mum.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
